story.iWant: to record screen and webcam simultaneously
story.soThat: I can create tutorials with my face visible
story.tasks: - Task 1: Add PiP mode to recordingStore - Task 2: Add "Picture-in-Picture" tab to RecordingModal - Task 3: Create PiP preview component - Task 4: Implement PiP position adjustment - Task 5: Implement PiP size adjustment - Task 6: Implement dual stream capture - Task 7: Save separate recording files - Task 8: Auto-import both clips to timeline - Task 9: Implement PiP compositing in preview - Task 10: Store PiP metadata with clips - Task 11: Handle edge cases and error scenarios - Task 12: Frame synchronization validation - Task 13: NFR Validation - Task 14: Testing and validation

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Recording setup modal includes "Screen + Webcam (PiP)" mode 2. User selects screen source (full screen or window) AND webcam device 3. Webcam preview overlay shows position on screen preview (adjustable corner/size) 4. Both screen and webcam captured as separate video streams 5. Recording produces 2 clips: screen recording (Track 1) and webcam (Track 2) 6. Both clips automatically placed on timeline in correct tracks 7. Webcam clip positioned as overlay/PiP in preview compositing

docs.doc: User selects PiP mode → choose screen source AND webcam device → PiP preview shows position/size adjustments → countdown → dual MediaRecorder instances start simultaneously → both files saved with same timestamp → auto-import screen to Track 1, webcam to Track 2 → PiP metadata stored with Track 2 clip.
RecordingConfig with mode, screenId, webcamId, pipPosition ('bottom-right' etc.), pipSize (number, not enum per tech spec line 199).

artifact.reason: Must add pipPosition, pipSize, screenStream, webcamStream, screenRecorder, webcamRecorder state fields.
Must implement PiP compositing with position/size from clip metadata.

story-context.constraints: - PiP position: 'bottom-right' | 'bottom-left' | 'top-right' | 'top-left' - pipSize type: number per tech spec (e.g., 0.25 = 25%), document if using enum - Both MediaRecorder instances start with same timestamp for sync - Both files use same timestamp in filename (screen-TIMESTAMP.webm, webcam-TIMESTAMP.webm) - Auto-import: screen → Track 1, webcam → Track 2 at position 0 - PiP metadata stored with Track 2 clip for preview/export - 20px padding from canvas edges for PiP positioning - Default: 25% size, bottom-right corner

tests.standards: Jest for unit tests. Manual integration testing for dual stream capture, file pairing, auto-import, frame sync validation.
tests.locations: src/renderer/src/store/__tests__/ Manual testing: PiP recording, dual file save, timestamp pairing, Track 1+2 import
tests.ideas: - AC1: Manual verify "Picture-in-Picture" tab in modal - AC2: Manual test selecting screen + webcam by IDs - AC3: Manual test PiP position adjustment (4 corners) - AC4: Manual test both MediaRecorder instances start simultaneously - AC5: Manual verify 2 files saved with same timestamp - AC6: Manual verify screen → Track 1, webcam → Track 2 auto-import - AC7: Manual verify preview compositing shows webcam overlay - Integration test: frame synchronization over 5-minute recording - Edge case: One stream fails, save successful stream only
